summary: Surveyed all 869 listed files (868 .lean paths incl. 14 lakefile.lean; all Lean). A declaration grep found 3495 theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque lines across 746 files covering OpenGALib (Riemannian metrics, geodesics, surfaces, varifolds, comparison geometry, Ricci-flow interoperability) and the PoincareConjecture Definitions/Theorems/Solutions/Verified trees. 123 files have no such declaration; of these, the 14 lakefile.lean files were read completely and hold only Lake package configuration, so they are excluded. The other 109 are import aggregators (FILTER-007, kept primary-eligible), #check navigation modules, and run_meta type/axiom audit harnesses that name project declarations; they are retained under the default because uncertain value is a downranking question, not a hard-exclusion case (FILTER-002, FILTER-021).
